Introduction

Nicha Yontararak, known under her stage name Minnie, is a Thai singer-songwriter, composer and actress under Cube Entertainment. She is best known as the main vocalist of the girl group i-dle, formerly known as (G)I-DLE.

On March 22, 2016, Minnie was first revealed to the public as a member of the trainee group Cube Tree.

On April 18, 2018, Minnie was revealed as the sixth and final member of i-dle. The group officially debuted on May 2, 2018, with their first mini album "I am".

In September 2020, Minnie made her acting debut in the Netflix sitcom "So Not Worth It" alongside Park Se-wan, Shin Hyun-Seung, GOT7's Youngjae, and Han Hyun-min.

On January 6, 2025, Cube Entertainment released a teaser announcement for Minnie's solo debut song to be released the following day. On January 7, 2025, Minnie officially released "Blind Eyes Red". On the same day, it was also announced that Minnie will be releasing her 1st Mini Album soon.

On January 21, 2025, Minnie released her 1st Mini Album with 7 tracks and the title track called "HER". The album composts of songs with featurings with fellow i-dle member Yuqi and Ten of WAYV.
